newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady awaiting cargo direction.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady awaiting cargo direction.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications were little changed from Thursday with traders' focus on the cargo market, industry sources said.
They said 180-cst prices were quoted at $121-$122 per tonne and 380-cst at $125-$127 per tonne.

Most shipowners were expecting prices to ease late Friday on ample supplies. But sellers said levels are likely to rise, tracking crude. Most players said they are keeping a close watch on cargo movements.
MDO and gasoil were steady quoted at $233 and $240-$246 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
